maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from LTL freight shipping services, not repair or maintenance of customers' installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private businesses shipping freight (retailers, manufacturers, distributors) on commercial credit terms, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically via its own service centers, fleet and technology investments; only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: LTL freight carriage is competitive; shippers can switch carriers fairly easily, despite service quality and account integration.
